proposal.reason: Primary change is CI execution behavior in .github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh: it reorders two build.sh passes and runs the test pass as `env -u LDFLAGS ... --enable_tests` so unit-test links avoid forwarded `-Wl,--allow-shlib-undefined` while the non-test pass keeps utility binaries and library linking behavior. This is test-workflow runner/environment orchestration (ci), not review-policy automation (workflow) and not a source build-rule/toolchain contract change in Makefiles (build).
